data.name: WanYaoChao
data.detailed_description:
In a broken world where the gods have fallen and the god above all gods has been sealed, time is coming to an end.

When the stars dim and the earth cracks, as all things face their finality, two forces clash in the Spirit Realm—the realm that spans reality and nothingness, the sealed land—destined for confrontation.

You, will choose to stand on which side?

Background

In ancient times, the God Above Gods waged a cataclysmic war against the gods. In the end, the God Above Gods was sealed beneath the "Demon-Sealing Stone," and the gods vanished without a trace. A thousand years later, the world was on the brink of destruction, the great calamity approaching.

"The Legion" rose up—a group of fervent radicals who believed that only by liberating the God Above Gods could they open the gateway to a new world, granting salvation to all beings.

Meanwhile, "The Alliance" remained steadfast in their faith: the power of the God Above Gods was sufficient to reshape the universe. Neither mortals nor gods could endure that creative might, and only by eternally sealing it could they avoid utter annihilation.

In this clash of ideals and destiny, the Spirit Realm became one of the final battlegrounds.

And you, will no longer just be a spectator.

In the court of myriads of demons, you will play different roles in the two factions, each identity possessing unique objectives.

Alliance Faction (Guarding the Seal)

Alliance Warrior: As the orthodox guardian, your mission is to reinforce the seal of the demon-stone and resist the erosion of the legion. Utilize sacred power to purify corruption, unite companions, and defend the last order.

Traitor of the Alliance: Once a guardian, now only seeks to survive in chaos. Betrayed their faith, wanders in the shadows, using intelligence and cunning to survive between the two factions.

Ghost Warrior: A wraith from the brink of death, sustained by the energy of the sealstone. You are not here to guard, but to devour the power of the seal, turning the spiritual realm's energy into your own use, reshaping yourself.

Legion Faction (Seal Destruction)

Legion Warrior: The liberator of the god above gods, charging forward, tearing open the rifts of the seal with your flesh and blood. Your belief is your strength, destruction is rebirth.

Lich: A forbidden sorcerer who wields the mysteries of life and death. You must make a choice: to break the seal and release the power of destruction and rebirth? Or to control the seal and become the new master above gods and men?

data.short_description: This is a multiplayer online role-playing battle game that combines exploration, strategy, and team collaboration with a visual perspective. Players must search for scattered seal stones throughout the map.
